description: Get an official, citable euro exchange rate for an invoice, ledger entry or tax return. Returns European Central Bank euro reference rates (about 30 currencies) for the latest business day or any date since 1999, with cross rates via any base currency, amount conversion, the ECB reference date actually used and a source link. Use when the rate must come from an official source rather than a market feed. $0.004 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: ecb_fx_rates
